data.one_liner: Apple AppIntent integration plugin for Siri, Shortcuts, and Apple Intelligence.
data.what_it_does: Integrates Apple's AppIntents framework into Flutter apps, letting users interact with the app via Siri, the Shortcuts app, and Apple Intelligence. It supports defining intents, entities, shortcuts, and listening to selection streams from native triggers.
use_when: You want your Flutter app to support Siri and Apple Shortcuts
You need to integrate Apple Intelligence features into your iOS app
avoid_when: You are building for Android or other non-iOS platforms
You do not need native OS assistant integrations
strengths: Enables deep iOS system integration with Siri and Shortcuts
Provides streams to handle intent triggers directly in Dart
weaknesses: Requires manual Swift code configuration in Xcode
data.setup_notes: Requires setting minimum iOS version to 16.0 in Xcode, adding Swift files for AppIntents, and configuring AppShortcutsProvider and AppDelegate bindings.
